description: This file defines the class 'CaseEventsHook' which handles tracking changes to case fields such as priority, status, assigned user, and type in a CRM system. It compares old and new case data to generate event records when specific fields change, and saves these events.

classes.name: CaseEventsHook
classes.description: A hook class for tracking and recording changes to case fields in the CRM system.

methods.name: compareBeans
methods.description: Compares two case beans and returns a list of event objects for each changed field.

methods.name: saveUpdate
methods.description: Saves update events for a case bean if relevant fields have changed, excluding new cases and imports.
